description: El Sonido del Rio is a 5000 sq. ft. private home with a 40 foot pool. It is situated on the river dividing Rincon from Aguada and boasts an outdoor BBQ area, massive marquesina with pool table, plenty of outdoor seating, a fruit-tree garden and river views. It is 10-15 minutes away from the beaches and towns of both Rincon & Aguada. With no next door neighbors, it is a truly private getaway.The spaceEl Sonido del Río is a private, “resort-style” home situated in the middle of a tropical oasis. The 3 bedrooms are fully furnished with queen beds sitting on handmade wooden bed frames, nightstands, rustic custom closets & luxurious 400 count 100% percale cotton sheets. The master has its own private entrance and workspace.All of the bedrooms are equipped with brand new Samsung split AC units that are kept between 70*F and 73*F, depending on the time of year and guest’s request. The common areas are equipped with industrial sized Samsung AC split units which remain at 75*F. Changes to the AC are controlled remotely by the hosts. The kitchen is fully equipped with all of your cooking necessities (from utensils, to pots and pans, mixing bowls, etc.), grilling utensils, a full set of dinner plates, cutlery and shatterproof-glasses. There are 2 full bathrooms inside the main residence, 1 of which is handicap accesible. Outside there is a split bathroom (shower and toilet in separate rooms, but next to each other). The 4th bathroom is a half bath located by the pool. The pool is 17 feet wide and 40 feet long and goes up to 5/12 feet deep. There is an 8 foot tanning ledge with Ledge Loungers at one end and a seated jacuzzi area on the other end with one long bench running alongside the pool and connecting the two areas. The pool deck is furnished with a table that seats 6, 4 lounge chairs, 3 umbrellas, a deck box with pool goodies, an outdoor shower to rinse off before entering and a half-bath for when nature calls. The pool area is gated and its two separate entrances have locking latches on each door. There is a shaded area just outside of the pool deck with a BBQ and two 4-seater patio sets.The “marquesina” or courtyard, has a life size connect-4, a Fusbol table, an XL domino table and a billiards table. Within the residence there is a cozy corner with the perfect selfie mirror and a selection of board games for those stay-inside-kind-of-days. The backyard is home to more than a dozen fruit trees ranging from starfruit, banana, lime, acerola, cranberry, june plum and mango, to name a few. The only next door neighbors you have and may get a visit from are iguanas, a variety of birds (from ducks to raptors like owls and hawks), Coqui frogs, and your usual share of Caribbean insects. Other than the river's lullaby choir of coqui and crickets, you can expect a totally peaceful and serene evening atmosphere as the sun tucks away and the pool lights flicker on.Guest accessGuests will have access to the entire property and residence with the exception of the 4th bedroom which will be closed and locked during their stay. If they have a larger group and would like access to the bedroom with the bunk beds they can book directly at our sister listing on Airbnb.

title: Above The Plaza 4 (6 guest)
description: Steps from Rincon's plaza, top-rated restaurants, craft brewery, farmers market & Thursday art walk. Beach in 10 min on foot.A flexible 3-room unit combining the front and middle sections of a downtown property. Sleeps 6 across 2 full beds and 2 twins, with 2 private bathrooms, full kitchen & individual A/C in every room. Perfect for families, friend groups & multi-generational trips.High-speed WiFi. Smart TV. Self check-in. Pets welcome for a fee. Free street parking.The spaceAbove the Plaza 4 is a spacious combination unit occupying the front and middle sections of the first floor — giving your group a connected, private space in the heart of downtown Rincon.The unit sleeps 6 across three rooms: one room with a full bed, one room with two twin beds, and a third room with a full bed. Two private bathrooms mean no waiting in the morning. The full kitchen is equipped with everything you need to cook in — cookware, dinnerware, appliances, and all the essentials. Every room has its own individual A/C unit so everyone stays comfortable. Two flat-screen Smart TVs and high-speed WiFi are available throughout.One thing to be upfront about: ATP4 is part of a shared building. Interior doors connect the unit to the rest of the property and remain closed during your stay. You have the front and middle sections entirely to yourselves — but this is a shared building rather than a fully standalone house.Rincon's plaza, top-rated restaurants, craft brewery, bakery, and weekly art walk are all a two-minute walk from your door. The beach is ten minutes on foot.Plenty of space, unbeatable location, everything within reach.Guest accessAbove the Plaza 4 is entirely yours — the full front and middle sections of the first floor with no shared spaces and no interruptions. Your group has complete privacy throughout your stay.Spread out across three rooms, cook in the full kitchen, and enjoy two bathrooms without the wait. This is your space to relax, reconnect, and make the most of everything Rincon has to offer right outside your door.Other things to noteA note on noise: the house sits on Rincon's main road, so you may occasionally hear passing traffic. In our experience guests find it easy to tune out — but we'd rather you know upfront than be surprised. The covered terrace in the back is your quiet escape when you want it.What you won't hear is Plaza noise. Despite being two minutes away on foot, the house sits just far enough from the action that evenings stay peaceful — the best of both worlds.

We left all the lights off because the first couple of hard rains in May and June every year makes termites in the trees hatch, these fly all over the island and are attracted by light. description: How would you like to stay at a beautiful tropical fruit and flower farm in wonderful Rincon, Puerto Rico? Mango Cabana is a quaint studio guesthouse located on a secluded exotic fruit and flower farm. Close to all the fun surf and party scene of Puntas, but at the end of a quiet road with a gorgeous ocean view, you'll have the best of both worlds.The spaceLocated on a 4 acre farm off the 413 about 3/4 mile from Sandy Beach the property has a beautiful ocean view at the end of a quiet street. The Cabana itself is a separate studio guesthouse that is about 300 sq/ft with screened windows and doors, a small bathroom and a kitchenette and a small side deck and has rooftop dining and relaxing.Enjoy the sights, sounds and flavors of the tropics. Tropical fruit and foliage abound at this property.Guest accessGuests can access all of the cabana and rooftop areas and immediate meadow area where they can pick their own fruit and enjoy the serenity of the area. For a tour of the farm and tropical botanical gardens, please let us know and we can tell you when we'll be out and about working and show you around! We live in a separate wooden cabin in the jungle on the property, so please respect the privacy of our home if you find it and do not access it.Other things to noteThis is an eco-friendly farm in the tropics. There are fans and screens, but no air conditioning. There also is no television. Nature in the tropics is right out your door and you will definitely hear it (which is super cool if you've never heard a jungle frog (coqui) sing at night or the troupials call in the day)! If you are sensitive to strange/unfamiliar sounds, bugs, geckos, humidity and other parts of tropical life, please note this. There is water, electricity and WIFI -though like everywhere in Puerto Rico there can be occasional unexpected interruptions in service. The Wifi is usually strong enough for basic internet needs, but may not be the best for high bandwidth needs, heavy use or long sessions of remote work.The cabana has a simple, modest kitchenette with a mini-fridge, sink, microwave, coffee maker and electric skillet (but please note there is NO stove/oven). Plan for light, simple meals if cooking.The studio cabana is available for up to two adults (18+) and is not suitable for children or pets. If you are looking for an interesting get-away, a connection with nature and a unique place to comfortably rest that is close to everything in Rincón and the surrounding areas this is the place for you. If you are looking for a luxury hotel with all the modern hotel and resort-style amenities including room service, this may not. This is a rustic cabin-style accommodation. Think minimal, simple outdoor living.Please no smoking inside and make sure to clean up after yourself. Welcome to Paradise! If you are laid back and into the island vibe, don't worry you’ll have a blast!
